instruction: When sending HTML emails to recipients who may not support HTML, I want Thunderbird to send both HTML and plain text versions. Please configure the email send format to send both HTML and plain text versions of messages.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting send format to both HTML and plain text (mail.default_send_format=3, where 3 means 'both'). Evaluator checks if the preference is set to 3. Uses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric function.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts Thunderbird preferences file (prefs.js) which contains the mail.default_send_format setting
Metric function check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses prefs.js using regex and compares mail.default_send_format value against expected value 3
Expected value is semantically correct: mail.default_send_format=3 means 'send both HTML and plain text', which matches the instruction requirement
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly the setting required by the instruction
Postconfig properly closes Thunderbird and waits to ensure preferences are flushed to disk before verification
No state timing issues: preference file will be accessible after Thunderbird closes

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
